known_limitations: studyFirstPostDate can be type ESTIMATED; it is still the first public registration date
startDate is often month-only (coarse) and is not a publication clock
the record carries no DOI/PMID link to publications, so paper-trial links must come from the paper side (NCT id in metadata)
sponsor names are marketing divisions ('Medtronic Cardiac Ablation Solutions'), requiring alias matching
licence: US federal government work; freely reusable
rate_limits: no published hard limit for the public API; keep pageSize modest (we used 2 and paced at 0.9s)
research_value: The single best public signal of a device firm's clinical pipeline: lead-sponsor attribution is a structured field, and studyFirstPostDate is a defensible first-public-knowledge clock.
